## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install BCG_DataScience_The_Forage in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure BCG_DataScience_The_Forage package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to BCG_DataScience_The_Forage
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/Ramon-PR/BCG-DataScience-The-Forage):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/Ramon-PR/BCG-DataScience-The-Forage.git
```

or from
[conda](https://anaconda.org/Ramon-PR/BCG-DataScience-The-Forage)

``` sh
$ conda install -c Ramon-PR BCG_DataScience_The_Forage
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/BCG-DataScience-The-Forage/)

``` sh
$ pip install BCG_DataScience_The_Forage
```
